listing.title: English Cocker Spaniel Sympathy Gift for Dog Owners, Memorial Board with Engraved Plate
listing.description:
A small, detailed relief of an English Cocker Spaniel sits above an engraved gold name plate on this cherry wood-look memorial board, made to honour a much-loved dog. It makes a thoughtful pet loss gift, a sympathy gift for someone who has lost a dog, or a lasting dog memorial for the home. The name, dates and words you choose are engraved on the plate, and the board can hang on a wall or stand on a shelf.

THE PIECE
- Board: MDF covered with a wood-look finish in a cherry color.
- Relief: a small dog head in low relief, made of cold cast bronze (bronze powder mixed with epoxy resin, poured into a silicone mold) and hand-designed by a Polish craftsman.
- Name plate: brushed gold laminate with black engraving.
- Size: the board is 34 x 24 cm (13.4 x 9.4 in).
- Display: hang it on the wall or stand it on a shelf.
- Care: wipe gently with a soft, slightly damp cloth and avoid detergents and chemical cleaners.

PERSONALISATION
Every board is made to order. Please tell us:
- Name and dates: the name and dates for the name plate, in any format you like.
- Quote: the name plate carries "You'll always be here with me, even if you're gone, you'll always have my love, our memory will live on." unless you give us your own exact wording.
- If the plate is meant for another occasion, such as an award, a distinction or a thank-you gift, we can change the engraving completely. Please contact us with a message first.

WAYS TO USE IT
- A memorial place at home: hang it on a wall or stand it on a shelf, a sideboard or a mantel.
- A gift for someone grieving: a lasting way to say you remember their dog too.
- A tribute for a dog who was part of the family, a working dog or a show dog.
- A custom plaque for any occasion: the text engraved on the gold plate can be anything you choose, so the board can also serve as an award, a distinction or a thank-you gift.

WHY YOU WILL LOVE IT
It brings together the details that matter: your dog's name and dates, a few words of your own and a small, detailed relief of the breed, all in one piece you can display in your own way. The warm wood tones and gold plate give it a calm, dignified look. For many owners it becomes a gentle point of remembrance at home.

INTERNATIONAL ORDERS
Our products are shipped from Poland, so import charges may apply in some countries. These charges do not apply to EU countries, the United Kingdom and the USA. If you have any doubts, please contact us for details.
